technical.summary: Momentum indicators show early bullish reversal signals (stoch cross, RSI rising, Ichimoku above cloud) but price remains below key moving averages with weak trend strength (ADX 17.66), limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 56 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed small trades from junior members; market sentiment neutral with slight bearish bias (38.5%) offset by greed reading; insufficient data for directional conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (157.7) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 56 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic bullish cross, Ichimoku above cloud, and supertrend bullish signal early momentum reversal with price near support (257.54), offering defined risk entry for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all key moving averages (EMA 9/21/50/200, SMA 200), ADX is critically weak at 17.66 indicating no trend strength, macro environment is severely adverse (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis), and zero fundamental support with high earnings risk in 56 days.

decision.entry_rationale: Early stochastic bullish cross and Ichimoku above cloud suggest momentum reversal at support, but price remains structurally below all key moving averages with critically weak trend strength (ADX 17.66), negating swing entry conviction.
